arrow-cursor.prompt: A single friendly cartoon mouse-pointer ARROW for a toddlers' app's default cursor, on a fully transparent background (real alpha, no paper, no white matte, no shadow, no glow, no background). The classic computer cursor arrow silhouette: a tall arrowhead whose sharp tip points to the upper left at the very top-left of the shape, with a short straight tail stem going down-right from the arrowhead's base, like the standard desktop arrow cursor, but with gently rounded corners everywhere except the pointed tip. Style: soft storybook watercolor look matching a gentle jungle picture book and the companion cartoon pointing-hand cursor: a warm honey-cream fill (#f6dc9a) with a slightly deeper golden-peach wash toward the lower right, one tiny soft leaf-green accent band across the tail stem, drawn for icon legibility: a bold, smooth, even dark warm-brown outline (#4a2e1f) around the whole silhouette, clean closed shapes, no texture noise, no stray paint specks, no text, no face. The tip must be a clear sharp point at the upper-left. The arrow fills most of the square canvas height, large simple shapes that stay readable when shrunk to 32 pixels. Square 1024x1024, transparent PNG.
